mechanism: Dexamethasone is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that increases dronedarone metabolism, reducing its plasma concentrations and antiarrhythmic efficacy; concurrent use also increases risk of hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, predisposing to arrhythmias.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor dronedarone efficacy closely, consider dose adjustment, and monitor electrolytes (potassium and magnesium) regularly during co-administration.
